pages: Jordan Rivera is applying for the Backend Engineer position at Cedarline Systems. The application focuses on reliable backend services.
At Blue Harbor Labs, Jordan built Python APIs processing 2 million events daily. Jordan used PostgreSQL and Redis for data storage and caching.

documents.content:
# Employee Policy
Employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave after probation. The probation period is 90 days. Resignation requires 30 days of written notice.
Invoice INV-731. The subtotal is INR 15,000. Tax is INR 3,450. The total due is INR 18,450. Payment is due October 15, 2026.
